questions.question: What is Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework used to build user interfaces quickly using predefined utility classes.
questions.answerMarathi: Tailwind CSS हे utility-first CSS framework आहे. यामध्ये p-4, m-2 आणि bg-blue-500 यांसारख्या तयार utility classes वापरून UI design पटकन तयार करता येते.
questions.codeExample: Hello Tailwind
questions.codeExplanation: Instead of writing separate CSS for every element, we apply utility classes directly to HTML elements.

questions.question: What is the difference between Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS आणि Bootstrap मध्ये काय फरक आहे?
questions.answer: Bootstrap provides predefined components, whereas Tailwind CSS provides utility classes for building custom designs.
questions.answerMarathi: Bootstrap मध्ये buttons, navbar आणि cards यांसारखे तयार components मिळतात. Tailwind CSS मध्ये spacing, colors, layout आणि typography साठी utility classes मिळतात. Bootstrap मध्ये predefined component styles असतात, तर Tailwind मध्ये design वर अधिक नियंत्रण मिळते.
questions.codeExample:
<button class="btn btn-primary">Bootstrap</button>
<button class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded">Tailwind</button>
questions.codeExplanation: Bootstrap is component-oriented, while Tailwind follows a utility-first approach.

questions.question: How do you install Tailwind CSS in a project?
questions.questionMarathi: Project मध्ये Tailwind CSS कसे install कराल?
questions.answer: Tailwind CSS can be installed using npm. The exact setup commands depend on the Tailwind CSS version and build tool.
questions.answerMarathi: Tailwind CSS npm वापरून install करता येते. मात्र Tailwind CSS च्या version नुसार configuration आणि build setup बदलू शकतो.
questions.codeExample:
npm install -D tailwindcss@3 postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p
questions.codeExplanation: For example, Tailwind CSS v3 commonly uses the following commands. Newer versions may use a different setup.

questions.question: What are Tailwind CSS breakpoints?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये breakpoints म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: Breakpoints are responsive prefixes that apply styles at specified screen widths. Common default prefixes include sm, md, lg, xl and 2xl.
questions.answerMarathi: Breakpoints वापरून screen size नुसार वेगवेगळ्या CSS styles लागू करता येतात. त्यामुळे mobile, tablet आणि desktop साठी responsive design तयार करता येतो.
questions.codeExample: Responsive Box
questions.codeExplanation: Tailwind uses a mobile-first approach. A prefixed utility applies at that breakpoint and above.

questions.question: How do you apply hover, focus and active states in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये hover, focus आणि active states कसे वापराल?
questions.answer: Use state variants such as hover:, focus: and active: before utility classes.
questions.answerMarathi: Element वर mouse नेल्यावर, keyboard focus मिळाल्यावर किंवा click केल्यावर style बदलण्यासाठी hover:, focus: आणि active: यांसारखे prefixes वापरतात.
questions.codeExample: <button class="bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-700 focus:ring-2 active:scale-95 text-white px-4 py-2">Click Me</button>
questions.codeExplanation: These variants make interactive elements easier to style without writing separate CSS selectors.

questions.question: How do you handle spacing in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये spacing कसे manage कराल?
questions.answer: Use margin utilities such as m-4 and padding utilities such as p-2.
questions.answerMarathi: Element च्या बाहेरील अंतरासाठी margin utilities आणि आतील अंतरासाठी padding utilities वापरतात. उदाहरणार्थ, m-4 म्हणजे साधारण 1rem margin आणि p-2 म्हणजे साधारण 0.5rem padding, default spacing scale नुसार.
questions.codeExample: Spacing Example
questions.codeExplanation: Spacing utilities include m-, mx-, my-, mt-, p-, px-, py- and gap-.

questions.question: What is the difference between inline, block, inline-block and flex in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये inline, block, inline-block आणि flex यांमध्ये काय फरक आहे?
questions.answer: inline stays in the text flow, block starts on a new line, inline-block stays inline while supporting box dimensions, and flex creates a flexbox container.
questions.answerMarathi: inline element एकाच ओळीत राहतो. block नवीन ओळीपासून सुरू होतो. inline-block एकाच ओळीत राहून width आणि height स्वीकारतो. flex वापरल्यावर flexbox layout तयार होतो.
questions.codeExample:
Inline
Block
Inline Block
AB
questions.codeExplanation: These utilities control the CSS display property.

questions.question: How do you center a div using Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS वापरून div center कसा कराल?
questions.answer: Use flex, items-center and justify-center to center content vertically and horizontally inside a container.
questions.answerMarathi: Container वर flex class लावून items-center वापरल्यास cross-axis वर आणि justify-center वापरल्यास main-axis वर content center करता येते. flex-row मध्ये हे अनुक्रमे vertical आणि horizontal centering असते.
questions.codeExample: Centered
questions.codeExplanation: The container needs sufficient height for vertical centering to be visible.

questions.question: What is JIT (Just-In-Time) mode in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मधील JIT mode म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: Just-In-Time compilation generates CSS for detected utility classes during development or build processing.
questions.answerMarathi: JIT म्हणजे Just-In-Time compilation. Tailwind project मधील वापरल्या जाणाऱ्या आणि detect झालेल्या classes साठी CSS generate करते. यामुळे अनावश्यक CSS कमी ठेवण्यास मदत होते.
questions.codeExample: Generated utility styles
questions.codeExplanation: JIT became the standard approach in Tailwind CSS v3. Production output depends on the build and detected classes.

questions.question: How do you customize colors in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये custom colors कसे add कराल?
questions.answer: Define custom colors in the theme configuration using the approach supported by your Tailwind version.
questions.answerMarathi: Project च्या Tailwind configuration मध्ये custom color define करून त्याचा utility class वापरता येतो. Configuration ची पद्धत version नुसार बदलू शकते.
questions.codeExplanation: In a Tailwind CSS v3 configuration, theme.extend adds colors without replacing the default palette.

questions.question: What is the difference between container and max-w-* in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मधील container आणि max-w-* मध्ये काय फरक आहे?
questions.answer: The container utility provides a responsive maximum width based on configured breakpoints, while max-w-* sets a specific maximum width.
questions.answerMarathi: container class breakpoints नुसार responsive width देते. max-w-* वापरून element ची maximum width अधिक स्पष्टपणे नियंत्रित करता येते.
questions.codeExample:
Page Container
Limited Width Content
questions.codeExplanation: Use container for common page wrappers and max-w-* when you need a particular width constraint.

questions.question: How do you create grid layouts in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये grid layout कसा तयार कराल?
questions.answer: Use grid to enable CSS Grid, grid-cols-* to set the number of columns, and gap-* to control spacing.
questions.answerMarathi: grid class वापरून CSS Grid सुरू करता येते. grid-cols-3 वापरल्यास तीन columns तयार होतात आणि gap-4 वापरल्यास त्यांच्यामध्ये अंतर मिळते.
questions.codeExample:
1
2
3
questions.codeExplanation: Grid utilities are useful for cards, galleries and dashboard layouts.

questions.question: How do you use responsive typography in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये responsive typography कशी वापराल?
questions.answer: Combine text-size utilities with responsive prefixes to change typography at different screen widths.
questions.answerMarathi: text-base, md:text-lg आणि lg:text-2xl यांसारख्या classes वापरून screen size नुसार font size बदलता येतो.
questions.codeExample: Responsive Text
questions.codeExplanation: Unprefixed styles apply by default; breakpoint-prefixed styles apply at their breakpoint and above.

questions.question: How do you handle dark mode in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये dark mode कसा implement कराल?
questions.answer: Use dark: variants and configure the dark-mode strategy supported by your Tailwind version.
questions.answerMarathi: dark: prefix वापरून dark theme साठी वेगळे styles लागू करता येतात. Class-based dark mode मध्ये application च्या एखाद्या parent element वर dark class लावून theme नियंत्रित करता येतो.
questions.codeExplanation: In Tailwind CSS v3, darkMode: 'class' is a common class-based configuration.

questions.question: How do you add custom fonts in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये custom fonts कसे add कराल?
questions.answer: Load the font into the application and configure a font-family utility using the supported Tailwind configuration.
questions.answerMarathi: Google Fonts किंवा local font load करून Tailwind configuration मध्ये font family define करता येते. त्यानंतर संबंधित utility class वापरता येतो.
questions.codeExplanation: In Tailwind CSS v3, custom font families are commonly added through theme.extend.fontFamily.

questions.question: What are Tailwind CSS plugins?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS plugins म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: Plugins extend Tailwind CSS with additional utilities, components or styling features.
questions.answerMarathi: Plugins वापरून Tailwind मध्ये अतिरिक्त utilities किंवा styling features जोडता येतात. उदाहरणार्थ, forms किंवा typography साठी संबंधित plugin वापरता येतो.
questions.codeExplanation: The installation and configuration depend on the plugin and Tailwind version.

questions.question: What are pseudo-class variants in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये pseudo-class variants म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: Pseudo-class variants apply styles based on an element's state or position, such as hover, focus, disabled, first, last, odd and even.
questions.answerMarathi: Element च्या state किंवा position नुसार style बदलण्यासाठी hover:, focus:, disabled:, first:, last:, odd: आणि even: यांसारखे variants वापरतात.
questions.codeExample: • List item
questions.codeExplanation: These variants let you style interactive states and list items directly with utility classes.

questions.question: What is the difference between relative, absolute, fixed and sticky positioning in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मधील relative, absolute, fixed आणि sticky यांमध्ये काय फरक आहे?
questions.answer: These utilities set the CSS position property to relative, absolute, fixed or sticky.
questions.answerMarathi: relative element च्या मूळ position च्या संदर्भात बदल करण्यासाठी वापरतात. absolute element जवळच्या positioned ancestor च्या संदर्भात ठेवले जाते. fixed viewport च्या संदर्भात ठेवले जाते, तर sticky scrolling दरम्यान ठरावीक मर्यादेत चिकटून राहते.
questions.codeExample:
Absolute
Fixed
Sticky Header
questions.codeExplanation: An absolute element is positioned relative to its nearest positioned ancestor, if one exists.

questions.question: How do you extend Tailwind CSS with custom utilities?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये custom utilities कशा add कराल?
questions.answer: Extend the theme for custom design tokens or use the custom utility APIs supported by your Tailwind version.
questions.answerMarathi: spacing, colors आणि font sizes यांसारख्या design values वाढवण्यासाठी theme configuration वापरता येते. गरजेनुसार custom utilities किंवा plugins देखील तयार करता येतात.
questions.codeExplanation: In Tailwind CSS v3, theme.extend.spacing can add custom spacing values.

questions.question: What is @apply in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मधील @apply म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: @apply lets you compose existing Tailwind utility classes inside a CSS rule.
questions.answerMarathi: @apply वापरून अनेक Tailwind utility classes एकत्र करून CSS class तयार करता येतो. याचा वापर पुनर्वापर करता येणाऱ्या styles साठी मर्यादित आणि योग्य पद्धतीने करावा.
questions.codeExplanation: It can help when integrating utilities into existing CSS, but overusing it may reduce the benefits of the utility-first approach.

questions.question: What are arbitrary values in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मधील arbitrary values म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: Arbitrary values allow custom CSS values to be used directly within utility class syntax.
questions.answerMarathi: Predefined scale मध्ये value उपलब्ध नसल्यास square brackets वापरून custom value देता येते. यामुळे specific width, margin किंवा color सहज सेट करता येतो.
questions.codeExample: Custom Values
questions.codeExplanation: Arbitrary values are useful for one-off design requirements.

questions.question: What are group and group-hover utilities in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये group आणि group-hover कसे काम करतात?
questions.answer: The group utility marks a parent element so child elements can respond to the parent's state using variants such as group-hover:.
questions.answerMarathi: Parent element वर group class लावल्यास child element वर group-hover: सारखा variant वापरून parent hover झाल्यावर child ची style बदलता येते.
questions.codeExplanation: This is useful for showing buttons, icons or overlays when hovering over a card.

questions.question: How do you truncate text or limit it to a specific number of lines in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये text truncate किंवा ठरावीक lines पर्यंत कसा दाखवाल?
questions.answer: Use utilities such as truncate, line-clamp-2 or line-clamp-3, depending on the required behavior and version.
questions.answerMarathi: एका ओळीत text truncate करण्यासाठी truncate वापरता येते. Text दोन किंवा तीन lines पर्यंत मर्यादित ठेवण्यासाठी line-clamp-2 किंवा line-clamp-3 वापरता येते.
questions.codeExample:
A long title that should remain on one line.

A long description that should be limited to two lines.
questions.codeExplanation: Check that the selected utility is supported by the installed Tailwind version.

questions.question: What are aspect-ratio utilities in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मधील aspect-ratio utilities म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: Aspect-ratio utilities maintain a specified width-to-height ratio for an element.
questions.answerMarathi: aspect-video किंवा aspect-square यांसारख्या utilities वापरून element चे width-to-height ratio कायम ठेवता येते. हे video, image आणि responsive card layouts साठी उपयुक्त आहे.
questions.codeExample: Video Preview
questions.codeExplanation: Modern Tailwind versions support utilities such as aspect-video and aspect-square.

questions.question: How do first, last, odd, even and focus-within variants work?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये first, last, odd, even आणि focus-within कसे काम करतात?
questions.answer: These variants apply styles based on an element's position in a group or the focus state of its descendants.
questions.answerMarathi: first: पहिल्या element साठी, last: शेवटच्या element साठी, odd: विषम क्रमांकाच्या आणि even: सम क्रमांकाच्या elements साठी style लागू करते. focus-within: parent किंवा त्याच्या descendant ला focus मिळाल्यास style लागू करते.
questions.codeExample: Table Cell
questions.codeExplanation: These variants are useful for lists, tables and accessible form controls.

questions.question: What are container queries in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मधील container queries म्हणजे काय?
questions.answer: Container queries allow an element's styles to respond to the size of its parent container rather than only the viewport.
questions.answerMarathi: Container queries वापरून parent container च्या width नुसार child element चे design बदलता येते. त्यामुळे वेगवेगळ्या आकाराच्या cards किंवा reusable components साठी responsive UI तयार करता येतो.
questions.codeExample: Container-responsive content
questions.codeExplanation: In Tailwind CSS v3.2+, container-query support may require the relevant plugin. Newer versions have built-in support.

questions.question: What are the performance best practices for Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS साठी performance best practices कोणत्या?
questions.answer: Use production builds, ensure source files are detected correctly, avoid unnecessary CSS, and use reusable patterns where appropriate.
questions.answerMarathi: Production build वापरा, source files योग्य प्रकारे detect होत आहेत याची खात्री करा, अनावश्यक CSS टाळा आणि गरजेनुसार reusable components तयार करा. Dynamic class names वापरताना build tool त्यांना detect करू शकतो का हे तपासा.
questions.codeExample: Responsive spacing
questions.codeExplanation: Modern Tailwind versions generate CSS from detected utility usage. Older versions may use a content or purge configuration.

questions.question: How do you use Tailwind CSS with React or Next.js?
questions.questionMarathi: React किंवा Next.js सोबत Tailwind CSS कसे वापराल?
questions.answer: Configure Tailwind for the application, import the generated styles, and apply utility classes in JSX. Libraries such as clsx can help build conditional class names.
questions.answerMarathi: React किंवा Next.js project मध्ये Tailwind configure करून global stylesheet import करता येते. JSX मधील className attribute वापरून utility classes लावता येतात. Conditional classes साठी clsx सारखी library उपयोगी ठरते.
questions.codeExplanation: Follow the setup recommended for the specific framework and installed Tailwind version.

questions.question: How do you create animations and transitions in Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: Tailwind CSS मध्ये animations आणि transitions कसे तयार कराल?
questions.answer: Use transition, duration, easing, transform and animation utilities to create visual effects.
questions.answerMarathi: transition, duration-300, ease-in-out आणि hover:scale-110 यांसारख्या classes वापरून smooth hover effects तयार करता येतात. Predefined animations साठी animate-spin आणि animate-pulse यांसारख्या utilities देखील वापरता येतात.
questions.codeExample: Hover Me
questions.codeExplanation: Transitions animate changes between states, while animation utilities can run predefined or configured keyframe animations.

questions.question: Why do companies prefer Tailwind CSS?
questions.questionMarathi: कंपन्या Tailwind CSS का वापरतात?
questions.answer: Companies may choose Tailwind CSS for rapid UI development, design consistency, customization and integration with modern frontend frameworks.
questions.answerMarathi: Tailwind CSS मुळे UI development जलद करता येते, design consistency राखता येते आणि custom responsive layouts तयार करणे सोपे होते. React आणि Next.js सारख्या frameworks सोबतही ते चांगल्या प्रकारे वापरता येते.
questions.codeExample:
Reusable UI

Responsive and customizable design.
questions.codeExplanation: Its benefits depend on the team's workflow, project requirements and design-system approach.
